rows.description: You stand by a friend even when it costs you. Wise: loyalty includes honesty and not covering harmful behaviour. Immature: defending them blindly against every criticism.
A friend stands up for you in a hard moment. Wise: feel grateful and return it in your own way. Immature: treating it as an entitlement or forgetting.

I decide to forgive my partner for a real wound and feel it will take time, not one sentence. Forgiving means letting go of revenge while still stating what must change; it is not pretending nothing happened.
I am being forgiven by my partner after I hurt them and feel grateful and undeserving. I do not demand quick forgiveness; I show through steady changed behaviour that I understood the harm.

I snapped at my child and now feel awful. Good parents also lose their temper. I apologise simply, name what happened, and reconnect; guilt that drives repair is healthy, guilt that drives overindulgence is not.

My child is screaming at me in a tantrum and I feel embarrassed and furious in public. I stay calm, keep them safe, and wait it out; the child needs me steady, and I gently repair later if I lost my temper.
A sibling seems to be the favourite or more successful. Wise: talk to parents and sibling about how it feels; compare less. Immature: sabotaging them or competing for approval.
Your sibling resents your success. Wise: do not shrink, but be generous, and listen to their feelings. Harmful: boasting or fuelling old wounds.

rows.subtype: Third person × Being the other person [Actor]
rows.description: You are drawn to someone already committed. Wise: see the risk of hurting others and yourself, and step back. Immature: believing you are special and the rules do not apply.

rows.subtype: Third person × Being the other person [Receiver]
rows.description: You learn the person you love was hiding a partner. Wise: feel the anger, end contact, and see you were also deceived. Harmful: fighting the other partner instead of facing the liar.
I check my phone every few minutes so as not to miss anything. Wise: notice the anxious pull, turn off notifications, and meet friends offline.
I keep posting for likes and feel low when they are few. Wise: notice the loop, post for reasons that are mine, and mute accounts that make me feel less.
